question.prompt: A sequence of numbers is defined recursively by \(a_1 = 1,\) \(a_2 = \frac{3}{7},\) and \[a_n=\dfrac{a_{n-2} \cdot a_{n-1}}{2a_{n-2} - a_{n-1}}\] for all \(n \geq 3.\) Then \(a_{2019}\) can be written as \(\frac{p}{q},\) where \(p\) and \(q\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(p+q ?\)

solutions.title: Make the reciprocals arithmetic
solutions.explanation:
Taking reciprocals separates the product in the recurrence into a difference. Set \(b_n=1/a_n\). Then
\[
b_n=\frac{2a_{n-2}-a_{n-1}}{a_{n-2}a_{n-1}}
=\frac{2}{a_{n-1}}-\frac{1}{a_{n-2}}
=2b_{n-1}-b_{n-2}.
\]
Rearranging gives
\[
b_n-b_{n-1}=b_{n-1}-b_{n-2}.
\]
Thus every successive difference is the same, so \((b_n)\) is an arithmetic sequence. Its first two terms are \(b_1=1\) and \(b_2=7/3\), giving common difference
\[
\frac73-1=\frac43.
\]
Therefore
\[
b_{2019}=1+(2019-1)\frac43
=\frac{3+8072}{3}
=\frac{8075}{3},
\]
so \(a_{2019}=3/8075\). Since \(8075\) is not divisible by \(3\), this fraction is reduced. Hence
\[
p+q=3+8075=\boxed{8078},
\]
which is choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
